surface: Group, Panel, Separator, persistence hooks, refs, imperative APIs, layout constraints, pointer and keyboard interaction, ARIA, cursor handling, and ResizeObserver behavior are implemented against react-resizable-panels 4.12.2.
divergences: useId(undefined) fallback cannot reproduce React's mocked ':r123:' seam; adapted upstream case asserts a non-empty Octane id and is recorded as react-resizable-panels-useId-fallback.
ssr: Deterministic server rendering and live hydration adoption are covered by dedicated executable projects.
